caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing human figure with brown skin, positioned on a rectangular black pedestal. The figure is adorned with a red garment draped over the left shoulder and across the chest, bordered with gold trim, and a green, gold, and grey tunic underneath, which also has gold and green borders at the edges. The figure wears a necklace, arm bands, and anklets, all colored gold. On the head, there is a headdress consisting of upright feathers in red, green, and yellow, attached to a band around the forehead. The figure's right arm is extended outward with the palm up, and the left arm is bent, hand near the waist, holding the draped garment. The figure is barefoot, with green and gold bands around the ankles and green sandals. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or patterns.
title: Cigar Store Indian
